entries.what_it_does: London-based AI cloud (neocloud): GPU capacity leased to AI labs. H1 2026 revenue $140.6M (+1,252% YoY); net loss $1.02B. Preliminary 9M 2026: revenue $307.5M, net loss $1.69B, debt ~$5.5B at Sep 30, 2026. entries.what_it_does: SoftBank's AI data-centre and power developer: builds gigawatt campuses to lease to AI companies, plus solar/battery power. Contracted backlog ~$439B (~$430B data centres, ~$10B power) — the filing's own estimate of future revenue under signed contracts, almost none earned yet. H1 2026 revenue $138.7M (legacy solar; data-centre revenue zero); FY2025 revenue $213.5M, net loss $738.0M. No data-centre capacity operating yet; 0.8 GW-IT under construction. Anchor tenant OpenAI (8.0 GW-IT, 20-year leases); Nvidia committed $3B to the deal.

note: Hand-authored, like lib/data/ipo_dossiers.json. Every figure is from the S-1 / F-1 on SEC EDGAR or from attributed press, and every forward-looking item is labelled expected/reported — never stated as fact. The weekly check (scripts/ipo_upcoming_check.py) only verifies filing status and whether a name has listed; it never edits this file. Qualification rule: a mega-IPO (raise >= $1B or valuation >= $10B) with a filing on record — public S-1/F-1, or a company-confirmed confidential filing. SPACs, funds and sub-$1B deals are not listed.
